decision.explanation: The name 'Bragin' refers to two distinct individuals in the provided sources: Lyudmila Bragina and Valeri Bragin. Document D1S1-D1S3 and D2S1-D2S5 describe Lyudmila Bragina as both a middle-distance runner (athletics) and an ice hockey player. Document D3S1-D3S7 describes Valeri Bragin as an ice hockey forward and coach. Since these are separate individuals with overlapping surnames, both 'athletics' and 'ice hockey' are valid associations depending on which Bragin is referenced. There is no contradiction within the context of distinct referents.
